header: What a partner gets, and what is expected in return
subheader: For resellers, integrators, affiliates and distributors.
lead: A split band with rich text beside a picture, over a grid of benefits that runs the full width underneath.
bodytext:
The rich text is where the obligations go, and it comes before the benefit grid on purpose: a partner page that only lists what somebody gets attracts exactly the applications nobody wanted to read.

Below the tablet breakpoint the two halves stack and the benefits follow at the width they had.
note: The note is for what happens after an application — how often they are looked at, and what an answer will and will not contain.

benefits.title: Zero to six benefits
benefits.text: Each an icon, a title and one sentence. Leave the collection empty and the band is a plain split.

benefits.title: Two to four columns
benefits.text: The grid reflows on the room it has rather than on the width of the viewport.

benefits.title: Media on either side
benefits.text: Reverse swaps the halves without changing the order the copy is read in.

benefits.title: One button, one link
benefits.text: The quieter action is for a reader who wants the terms before the form.
